company_info.description: One of Malaysia's leading integrated palm oil companies with strong sustainability practices

analysis.method: Sentinel-2 Satellite Imagery Analysis + RSPO Verification
analysis.indicator: Forest Cover Change & HCV Area Protection

evidence.conclusion: No new deforestation detected. Company has maintained and increased High Conservation Value (HCV) areas. Active reforestation of 450 hectares completed in 2022-2023.

compliance.eudr: ✅ Fully compliant with EU EUDR (zero deforestation since 2020)

key_events.event: IOI received RSPO Excellence Award for Best Smallholder Support Program
key_events.impact: Recognized for outstanding support to over 8,000 smallholder farmers through training, financing, and market access programs.

key_events.event: IOI achieved 100% traceability to plantation level for all palm oil
key_events.impact: Full supply chain transparency achieved ahead of EUDR requirements. This significantly reduces risk for downstream buyers.

key_events.event: IOI published its first Living Wage Report with third-party verification
key_events.impact: Demonstrates commitment to fair wages. All workers now receive at least living wage as defined by local benchmarks.

traditional_rating.description: Strong ESG performance with consistent improvement. AA rating reflects leadership in sustainable palm oil practices.

metrics.labor_complaints: Less than 15 formal complaints in 2023 (all resolved within 30 days)
metrics.smallholder_support: Over 8,000 smallholders supported with training and financing
metrics.women_employment: 28% female workforce with equal pay policy

upstream.name: IOI Corporation Berhad
upstream.production_capacity: Annual production ~1.2 million tons CPO + downstream refining

midstream.name: IOI Edible Oils & Fats
midstream.role: Refining, fractionation and specialty oils manufacturer

regulations.eu: Fully prepared for EUDR. All volumes traceable to plantation with geolocation data.
regulations.us: No forced labor issues. Strong due diligence in place. Low risk of CBP action.
regulations.china: Strong demand for sustainable and traceable palm oil. Green premium achievable.

market_impact.china: Low Risk - Growing preference for sustainable sourcing

impact_alert.message:
✅ LOW RISK SUPPLIER

IOI Corporation demonstrates strong ESG performance across both environmental and social dimensions. Key strengths:

• Zero deforestation policy with satellite monitoring
• 100% traceability to plantation
• Strong smallholder support program
• Living wage commitment verified
• Excellent traditional ESG ratings (MSCI AA)

Recommended as a preferred sustainable supplier for EUDR-compliant supply chains.

risk_scenarios.impact: Continued leadership in sustainable palm oil. Potential to become preferred supplier for major EU brands seeking EUDR compliance.
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Strengthen long-term partnership and consider joint smallholder projects.

risk_scenarios.impact: Minor isolated labor or environmental incident at one plantation. Quickly resolved with transparent reporting.
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Maintain close monitoring and require quarterly ESG reports.

risk_scenarios.impact: Significant negative event (e.g. major spill or labor dispute) leading to temporary reputation damage.
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Diversify slightly while maintaining strong relationship with IOI as anchor sustainable supplier.
